items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came by to sit in, and I liked him, so I hired him.

ctx.x: Where he was from, where he grew up.
That’s where he was from, yeah. He came by to sit in, and I liked him, so I hired him.
I’d like to ask you a general question about balancing your creative impulses with the function of doing the gig, and how you satisfy your creativity within the dictates of making a living?
